title: Photovoltaic Power Generation: Multidimensional Indicators, Forecasting, Optimization and Carbon Assessment
description: Data and exploratory analysis materials accompanying a multidimensional study of photovoltaic power generation. The archive links indicator construction and data-quality checks with power-production forecasting, particle-swarm planning optimization, and scenario-based carbon assessment. It includes tabular inputs and Python/MATLAB scripts for preprocessing, distributional diagnostics, dimensionality reduction, regression, visualization, and optimization. The README documents file organization, methods, assumptions, citation, and licensing limits. Long-horizon projections are scenario estimates rather than production dispatch guarantees, and all results depend on the stated historical definitions and assumptions.
